faction.cmd.faction: /faction <create|invite|accept|decline|kick|leave|rank|perm|info> - your faction, also on the Faction tab of the F10 menu
faction.cmd.chat: /f <text> - to your faction, wherever its members are
faction.cmd.manage: /afaction <dissolve|rename|lead|remove> <faction> <reason, name or member> - dissolve or rename a faction, make a member its leader or remove one
faction.use.list: The faction commands: create, invite, accept, decline, kick, leave, rank, perm, info, rankadd, rankdel, rankname, rankmove. /faction alone opens the Faction tab.
faction.use.create: /faction create <name> founds a faction for {fee} gold.
faction.err.founding: Your faction is being founded. Wait a moment.
faction.err.name_length: A faction's name has {min} to {max} characters.
faction.err.name_shape: A name is made of Latin letters and digits, starts with a letter, and takes single spaces, apostrophes and hyphens between them.
faction.err.name_taken: There is a faction called {name} already.
faction.err.fee: Founding a faction costs {fee} gold, you carry {gold}.
faction.err.full: The faction is full, the limit is {max} members.
faction.err.may_not_kick: Your rank may not remove members.
faction.err.may_not_ranks: Your rank may not manage ranks.
faction.err.kick_self: You cannot remove yourself. Leave with /faction leave.
faction.err.outranked: {name} holds your rank or a higher one.
faction.err.sole_leader: You are the faction's only leader. Give the leader's rank to another member first.
faction.err.own_rank: You cannot change your own rank.
faction.err.rank_not_below: You only change and give ranks below your own.
faction.err.grant_unheld: You only give or take a permission you hold yourself.
faction.err.ranks_full: The faction has all its {max} ranks.
faction.err.rank_fixed: The leader's rank and the entry rank stay where they are.
faction.err.rank_edge: That rank cannot go further that way.
faction.err.rank_name_length: A rank's name has {min} to {max} characters.
faction.err.rank_name_taken: There is a rank called {name} already.
faction.err.no_member: Your faction has no member "{text}". Give a player number or the full name.
faction.err.no_invite: You have no invitation to a faction.
faction.err.invite_gone: The invitation to {faction} no longer holds.
faction.cooldown: You can invite again in {seconds} s.
faction.founded: You founded {name} for {fee} gold. You are its leader.
faction.founded_free: You founded {name}. You are its leader.
faction.found_failed: The faction could not be founded. The fee is back with you.
faction.asked: {name} invites you to join {faction}. Press Y to join or N to decline within {seconds} s, or answer on the Faction tab of the F10 menu within {minutes} min.
faction.invited: You invited {name} to {faction}. The invitation is good for {minutes} min.
faction.left_last: You were the last member of {faction}, so it is dissolved.
faction.perm.granted: The rank {rank} now has the permission: {permission}.
faction.perm.taken: The rank {rank} no longer has the permission: {permission}.
faction.rank.added: The rank {name} is added, above the entry rank.
faction.rank.deleted: The rank {rank} is deleted. Whoever held it is now {entry}.
faction.staff.err.no_faction: There is no faction "{text}". Give its name or #number, which the panel's Factions tab shows.
faction.staff.err.no_member: "{text}" is no member of {faction}. Give a player number, #number or the full name.
faction.staff.err.last_member: {name} is the last member of {faction}. Dissolve it instead.
faction.staff.err.sole_leader: {name} is the only leader of {faction}. Make another member a leader first.
